description: PCI-DSS scope reduction exercise for an e-commerce platform. Must: implement tokenization for credit card data (replace PANs with tokens), segment the cardholder data environment (CDE) from the rest of the network, configure firewall rules to isolate CDE, collect compliance evidence (network diagrams, firewall configs, tokenization logs), verify scope reduction via ASV scan, and document the new scope boundary. Risk factors: tokenization breaking payment processing, network segmentation too strict blocking required flows, evidence collection incomplete failing audit. Tools available: terraform, aws CLI, VPC, nginx, PCI scanning tools.
